column1: comment
The new dashboard is intuitive and saves me hours every week. Huge improvement over the old system.
Loading times are unacceptably slow. I waited over 30 seconds for the reports page to open.
I appreciate the recent bug fixes but the mobile experience still needs significant work.
Customer support responded within the hour and resolved my issue completely. Very impressed.
The pricing increase was not communicated properly. We found out when we got the invoice.
Feature requests from 2 years ago are still not implemented. Feels like feedback goes nowhere.
The API documentation is clear and well-maintained. Our dev team had no trouble integrating.
Onboarding process was confusing. We needed three calls with support just to get started.
Solid product overall. Does what it says. Nothing extraordinary but reliable and consistent.
The export functionality is broken again. This is the third time this quarter.
Really happy with the latest update. The new filtering options are exactly what we needed.
The system went down during our quarterly review. That was an embarrassing situation.
Performance has noticeably improved since the last release. Good work on the backend.
I have no strong feelings either way. We use it, it works, nothing to complain about.
The collaboration features are excellent. Our remote team can finally work in sync.
Billing support was unhelpful and kept transferring me between departments.
The UI is clean and modern. Much better than competitors we evaluated.
Notifications are buggy and inconsistent. I miss important alerts regularly.
Documentation is thorough. I solved my issue without contacting support.
We are evaluating alternatives because the stability issues have not been addressed.
